outlet: Board of Lincoln County Commissioners, minutes of the April 6, 2026 regular meeting
title: Minutes (PDF), April 6, 2026
notes: Prosecuting Attorney Ty Albertson advised the board to re-advertise the county printing contract after two late bids, and reported the chief deputy prosecutor's resignation effective May 31, 2026; the board approved reclassifying the deputy positions and hiring a Deputy Prosecutor II.
